visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Array Comes Out Unchanged
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The array 1 2 3 4 5 should print as 5 4 3 2 1, but it prints 1 2 3 4 5 again.

solution.explanation: Each swap fixes two positions, so only half of the array needs visiting. Looping to n swaps every pair twice, which puts every element back where it started.
